print(binned)

# Polynomial fit for pressure-conversion

print(f"\n=== PRESSURE 2ND-ORDER FIT ===")
print(f"Coeffs: {coeffs}")
print(f"R2 (2nd order): {r2:.3f}")
print(f"Peak at pressure: {-coeffs[1]/(2*coeffs[0]):.1f}")
